text.en: OFA is row 31 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Multimodal area.
text.zh: OFA 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 31 行，所属领域为“多模态”。

text.en: The annual table associates OFA with “OFA: Unifying Architectures, Tasks, and Modalities Through a Simple Sequence-to-Sequence Learning Framework”.
text.zh: 年度表把 OFA 与论文《OFA: Unifying Architectures, Tasks, and Modalities Through a Simple Sequence-to-Sequence Learning Framework》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Peng Wang, Chang Zhou”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Peng Wang（官方页拼写）、Chang Zhou（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Peng Wang, Chang Zhou”。
